f.m.progress: every 9 weeks with the report card
f.red[0].beh: Grabbing and property aggression: taking an item from another person's hands or desk, throwing or sweeping items off a surface, or pushing a person while reaching for an item. Not: picking up an unattended item.
f.red[0].cur: 0.6 per minute (EA-1 tangible condition; 4.1 per day on DD-1)
f.red[0].ctx: Middle-school ESE resource room and general education electives; 1:1 para for electives
f.red[0].meth: a frequency count in every session, recorded on DD-1 by the classroom staff
f.acq[1].beh: wait calmly, without problem behavior, until the item or activity comes
f.acq[1].cond: a request made and the adult saying "Wait, please" with a timer started
f.acq[1].crit: for waits of up to 5 minutes, in at least 90% of opportunities
f.acq[1].meth: the wait reached and any problem behavior, each trial, on Form DT-1
f.acq[1].note: From the objective bank: Wait for a requested item or activity (Fisher et al., 2000; Ghaemmaghami et al., 2016; Austin & Tiger, 2015; Jessel et al., 2018; Hagopian et al., 2011; Stevenson et al., 2016).
